name: mimo-delegator
description: 将编码任务委派给 MiMo CLI 后台 Worker；支持 pure 隔离、范围保护、取消和验证。 Delegate coding tasks with isolation, scope guards, cancellation, and verification.

interface.shortDescription: 委派大型任务给 MiMo，节省 Codex Token / Delegate large tasks and save Codex tokens.
interface.longDescription: 通过持久后台 Worker 运行 MiMo CLI，并提供 pure 隔离、紧凑状态查询、取消、文件范围保护和验证重试；Codex 保留最终验收权。 Runs MiMo in persistent workers with isolation, status checks, cancellation, scope guards, and verification retries; Codex retains acceptance control.
defaultPrompt: 将大型编码任务委派给 MiMo，并独立验证结果。 Delegate a large coding task to MiMo and independently verify the result.
